content.text:
Findings at ref `8362b3c`. Headline: **the footer is not uniquely affected — the homepage is the bigger blast radius.**

---

## 1. useUiCopy / UiCopyProvider — degrades gracefully, never throws, never blanks

**`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/hooks/useUiCopy.ts`**
- L19-22 — the no-Provider fallback object:
  ```ts
  const FALLBACK_ONLY: UiCopyContextValue = {
    t: (_key: string, fallback: string) => fallback,
    isLoading: false,
  };
  ```
- L38 — the exact mechanism: `export const useUiCopy = (): UiCopyContextValue => useContext(UiCopyContext) ?? FALLBACK_ONLY;`
- L17 — context default is `undefined`, so no Provider ⇒ `FALLBACK_ONLY`. No `throw` anywhere in the file.

**`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/uiCopyProvider/index.tsx`**
- L19 — `const { data, isLoading } = useContentfulEntries<UiCopyEntry>('uiCopy');` — **`error` is deliberately not destructured**, so a fetch failure is inert.
- L21-28 — `(data ?? []).forEach(...)` ⇒ null data yields an empty Map.
- L32 — `const t = useCallback((key, fallback) => copyMap.get(key) ?? fallback, [copyMap]);` ⇒ empty Map ⇒ every lookup returns the caller's fallback.
- L29-31 comment states the intent explicitly: *"Fallback-on-failure by design… losing a button label or a status message to a Contentful outage should never blank a control."*

**Mount point:** `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/_app-config/index.tsx:159` — `<UiCopyProvider>{children}</UiCopyProvider>`, inside `ChakraProvider` (L156) inside `ContentfulLivePreviewProvider` (L155). Mounted once, app-wide. No error boundary needed because it cannot throw.

**Fetch layer** `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts:88-155` — `useContentfulEntries` catches everything: missing config ⇒ `setError` + `setIsLoading(false)` (L98-102); non-OK response ⇒ `console.error` + throw caught at L146-150 ⇒ `setError`, `data` stays `null`. Relevant for a truly empty environment: CDA returns **HTTP 400** for `content_type=uiCopy` when the content type doesn't exist ⇒ this path ⇒ fallbacks. No rethrow, no unhandled rejection.

**Tests confirm:** `overrides/app/hooks/useUiCopy.test.tsx:7-12` ("falls back… with no UiCopyProvider mounted"); `overrides/app/components/uiCopyProvider/index.test.tsx:57-64` (null data + loading) and `:66-72` ("falls back on fetch error without throwing").

Note: the only two `useUiCopy` consumers on a rendered page are `overrides/app/components/footer/bottomBar/index.tsx:35-36` and `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmSubscribeSection/index.tsx:52-56` — both rendered **only inside the footer** (`overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:95`), so if the footer nulls out they never mount anyway.

---

## 2. Every Contentful consumer in `overrides/` and its empty/failure behaviour

| Consumer | Content type asked for | Behaviour on error / zero items |
|---|---|---|
| `overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx:148` `useContentfulEntries<HomepageEntry>('homepage')` | `homepage` | **`overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx:163` — `if (!homepageContent) return null;`** ⇒ entire homepage body blank |
| `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:194-207` `client.getEntries({ content_type: 'footerConfig', include: 3 })` | `footerConfig` (+ `footerNavGroup`, `link`, `region` via includes) | `.catch(() => setFooterData(null))` L205-207, then **L214 `if (!footerData) return null;`** ⇒ no footer |
| `overrides/app/components/uiCopyProvider/index.tsx:19` | `uiCopy` | silent fallback (section 1) |
| `overrides/app/pages/experience/index.tsx:28-33` `useFetchBySlug({ experienceTypeId: 'collectionPageExp' })` | `collectionPageExp` (Experience type) | L51-63: `<Seo noIndex />` + red `"Page not found."` in a `Box` — **HTTP status stays 200** (L52-54 comment: *"a true HTTP 404 isn't set here"*) |
| `overrides/app/pages/experience/index.tsx:104` `useContentfulClient` | n/a | `previewUnavailable` ⇒ 404 + "Preview is not enabled…" (L129-141); `!client` ⇒ **`res.status(500)`** + "Contentful configuration is missing" (L143-157) |
| `overrides/app/pages/contentfulPreview/index.tsx:86` `client.getEntry(entryId)` then `:25-30` `useFetchById` | any Experience type (resolved dynamically at L89) | `typeError` ⇒ red "Could not load entry: …" (L109-115); `!experience` ⇒ orange "Entry found (type: X) but it could not be rendered as a Contentful Experience…" (L48-58); no `entryId` ⇒ "Missing 'entry' query parameter" (L157-167) |
| `overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx:175` `useContentfulEntry(entryId, true)` (preview only, `?entry=`) | any | error ⇒ red "Error loading preview: …" (L186-192); `!liveData` ⇒ `return null` (L194); wrong type ⇒ "Preview for content type X is not yet configured." (L198-204) |

`overrides/app/components/contentful/{heroBanner,duplexSection,videoEmbed,productHero}.tsx` are **purely presentational** — zero `fetch`/`useContentful*`/`useEffect` hits in that directory. They are prop-fed from the `homepage` entry at `overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx:64-80` and guarded by `fields.X &&` on each line, so they can never render standalone. Same for `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/{collectionHero,imageText}.tsx` — they only render inside `<ExperienceRoot>`; `experiences/definitions.ts` is a side-effect `defineComponents()` registration, no network call.

`overrides/app/config/contentfulMapping.ts` / `.generated.ts` are static locale/site constants, no fetch.

**The critical one:** `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx:155-165`
```ts
if (contentfulLoading) { return (<Box …><Spinner size="xl" /></Box>); }
if (!homepageContent) return null;
return <HomepageContent fields={homepageContent.fields} entryId={homepageContent.sys.id} />;
```
With no `homepage` content type/entry, `contentfulData` is `null` ⇒ `null` ⇒ the whole `<HomepageContent>` tree never mounts. That includes the **SFCC "Shop Products" `ProductScroller`** (L81-129), which lives *inside* `HomepageContent` — so even the non-Contentful part of the homepage disappears. Because `useEffect` doesn't run during SSR, `isLoading` starts `true`, so the SSR HTML ships the Spinner and the client resolves it to a blank `<div data-testid="home-page">` containing only `<Seo>`.

---

## 3. routes.tsx — Experience pages ARE on the main route table

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/routes.tsx`
- L29-33 — `/` → `Home` (the Contentful-backed home above), `exact: true`.
- L38 — `..._routes` — all base SFCC routes (PLP `/category/:categoryId`, PDP `/product/:productId`, cart, checkout, account) spread **before** the Contentful catch-all.
- L40-44 — `/preview` → `ContentfulPreview`, `exact: true` (editor-only, `<Seo noIndex/>`).
- **L45-49 — `{ path: '/:slug', component: Experience }`** with the comment *"fallback after all SFCC routes. `configureRoutes` strips PWA Kit's '\*' catch-all so this is safely reached only for paths no other route matched."*
- L53-55 — `configureRoutes(routes, config, { ignoredRoutes: ['/callback', '*'] })`.

So: PLP and PDP are matched by the base SFCC routes and are **completely unaffected** by an empty Contentful environment. The homepage **is** affected. `/:slug` is a real public route, not a `/preview`-gated one — with an empty environment every unmatched path renders the red "Page not found." text at a **200 status** (`overrides/app/pages/experience/index.tsx:51-63`), which is the same behaviour it already has today for any unknown slug.

---

## 4. Header — zero Contentful dependency

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx` (460 lines, the only file in that directory): `git grep -iE "contentful|useUiCopy"` over `overrides/app/components/header/` returns **no matches**. Its data sources are `useIntl` (L5), `useAuthHelper`/`useCustomerType` (L26), `useCurrentBasket` (L28), `getConfig` (L64) — all SFCC/local. Header renders identically against an empty Contentful environment.

---

## Bottom line for an empty Contentful environment (no content types, no entries)

- **Homepage: blank body** (header + nothing + no footer). Worst regression, worse than the footer — `overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx:163`.
- **Footer: absent app-wide** — `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:214`.
- **Any non-SFCC path (`/:slug`): red "Page not found." at HTTP 200** — `overrides/app/pages/experience/index.tsx:51-63`.
- **`/preview`: error text** (or 404 if no CPA token) — `overrides/app/pages/contentfulPreview/index.tsx:143-155`.
- **Header, PLP, PDP, cart, checkout, account: unaffected.**
- **uiCopy microcopy: silently falls back to hardcoded English defaults, never throws, never blanks a control.**

One asymmetry worth flagging to whoever asked: `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:56-57` documents the null-render convention as applying to *"every other Contentful-backed component in the repo (`DuplexSection`, `HeroBanner`, `ProductHero`, `VideoEmbed`)"* — but those are prop-guarded leaves, whereas `HomeNormal`'s `return null` takes out the SFCC product scroller along with the CMS content.
